text: Implemented multiblock algebra in modules/multivar: BlockSpec global/local column mapping, BlockwisePreprocessor with block-local fitted preprocessors composed into global affine order, BlockMap, BlockMapComponent, MultiblockProjection, and CrossProjection.transfer with explicit decoder capability. Added tests for blockwise preprocessing global order, BlockMap summed projection, projectBlock restriction semantics, MultiblockProjection delegation, and typed cross-domain transfer. Verified with sbt "multivarJVM/test" "multivarJS/test"; both passed 31 tests. Removed generated multivar target directories after verification; git diff --check passed for modules/multivar.
